comment: When I want to say I love you.
Everything is visibly falling apart, but the person in charge keeps saying it is fine.
I was perfectly happy with my current phone until I saw the shiny new model.
No thanks to the complicated enterprise tool; yes please to the simple spreadsheet that works.
A furious person is shouting while the cat at the table looks completely confused.
I have two choices, and somehow both buttons lead to disaster.
I ignored every obvious warning and am now genuinely shocked by the predictable result.
I am smiling politely even though everything inside me is suffering.
Finishing this migration is nowhere near as simple as people keep claiming.
The deployment finally worked after a week of failures, and I feel victorious.
The test cannot fail if nobody ever runs the test.
I am quietly sipping tea while watching drama that has nothing to do with me.
I caused the chaos and now I am calmly watching it unfold from a safe distance.
The four-step plan looked perfect until the final panel revealed that it had completely failed.
Trade offer: I receive all the credit, and you receive all the extra work.
The supposedly new production problem had actually been there all along.
When I need to introduce myself by saying my name is Jeff.
I have been waiting for this approval for so long that I may become a skeleton.
I studied all night for the exam, and the only topic I skipped was the entire test.
I realized everyone heard my embarrassing comment, so I quietly looked away and pretended nothing happened.
I am giving the strongest side-eye because this explanation makes absolutely no sense.
I sleep through the boring option but immediately wake up for the exciting one.
